# native references for hidden end-of-cell paragraphs

Original controls authored directly as OPC/XML, without a third-party document
engine or template content. The reference application exported these references on
2026-09-18; sources were closed without saving.

`native-spacing.pdf` and `native-spacing.json` describe
`public/fixtures/hidden-cell-mark.docx`. The JSON records source/PDF SHA-256
and the reference application's automation API paragraph measurements. With no styles part, the reference application reports 8pt
after spacing and multiple line spacing (13.9pt / 12pt). The empty hidden
third row nevertheless occupies its 3pt minimum.

`spacing-controls-native.pdf` renders
`public/fixtures/hidden-cell-spacing-controls.docx`, generated by
`tools/canvas_hidden_cell_spacing_fixture.py` from the original fixture's OPC
scaffold. Eight labeled, single-cell tables isolate empty hidden paragraphs:
automatic spacing with zero/before/after/both 8pt gaps; exact 12pt and minimum
12pt line spacing, each with zero or both 8pt gaps. All use a 36pt paragraph
mark, zero cell margins, 3pt row minimum and 0.5pt borders.

Every native reference row retains the 3pt content minimum rather than paragraph/line
spacing. PDF border inner-edge pairs, in points from page top:
84.50–87.50, 100.46–103.58, 116.54–119.54, 132.50–135.50,
148.46–151.58, 164.54–167.54, 180.50–183.50, 196.46–199.58.
The 0.12pt variation is PDF placement rounding. This evidence documents the reference application's
spacing interaction with ECMA-376 Part 1 §17.4.21, not a claim that the clause
explicitly specifies these spacing rules.

SHA-256:

- Controls DOCX: `392fc04a7a9a49ec42e49d22a2ca99d3df79db005b1b153ec73520e5f9104b61`
- Controls PDF: `534e0e4f349ec829c6a558fb4741daa84db0b3371eaf7beb563d14cf45a46ed0`

Unit coverage verifies all controls collapse, typing restores their stored
formatting, exports reopen with the same geometry, and undo restores exact OPC
parts. The browser test exercises typing, copy/paste, download and reopening.

`tools/record_hidden_picture_height.py` extracts the seventh row's 20.04pt
height from the original PDF cell clipping rectangle. It confirms that the
12pt inline picture is followed by the 8pt after-gap, without multiplying the
picture's height by automatic spacing. The hidden mark contributes no text
leading in this legacy-mode image-only cell. Browser coverage compares this
measurement within the same 0.15pt tolerance as the inline-object controls,
replacing an older test formula that incorrectly expected a 21.9pt row.
